description: Start the automation bridge on a device. Required before interacting with the device. For cloud devices this allocates the provider session; pass "app" to pick the app under test (e.g. the appRef returned by install_app).

app.description: Cloud devices only: provider app ref to install at session start (bs://…, storage:…, AWS upload ARN). Overrides the saved session config. Ignored for local devices.

run_options.description: Cloud devices only: free-form provider run options (string values) merged into the session config.

name: start_bridge
